edit.description: bound baseTree's laid-down selection with the homed escape verdict before the checkout
shrink readLine's outside-path test to that same spelling

summary: Bound a base run's selection with escapesRoot at baseTree, the one site that lays it down; scriptRunner's own prefix test is a fourth spelling that misses an interior climb

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: A selected file that resolves outside the base checkout is refused before `git worktree add`, at baseTree, for every runner; scriptRunner's readLine reaches the same verdict through escapesRoot rather than a startsWith test of its own.
tests: baseTree refuses a selected file that lands outside the base checkout
the script runner refuses a pass line whose file climbs out of the run tree
notes: Verified: gitPath (src/paths.ts:77) folds separators only, so scriptRunner.ts:140's `startsWith("../")` accepts `checks/../../outside.txt`, which toolRun.ts:133 copyFiles to `<worktree>/../outside.txt`. escapesRoot (src/paths.ts:95) rules it an escape and its own doc names a fourth spelling as the defect. vitestRunner's files come from `relative()` and are unbounded too, so the fix belongs at baseTree.
